scenario_1_straight_acceleration.description: Straight line acceleration from standstill with throttle=1.0 for 100 ticks

scenario_2_braking.description: Full braking from initial speed of 600 px/s with brake=1.0 for 100 ticks

scenario_3_reverse_transition.description: Reverse gear engagement via brake hold, reverse acceleration, then forward throttle recovery

scenario_4_steering_turning.description: Continuous turn with throttle=1.0 and steer=0.75 evaluating low-speed ease curve and yaw dynamics

scenario_5_drift_counter_steer.description: Deep drift followed by counter-steer evaluating yaw damping and lateral slip retention

scenario_6_nitro_burn_regen.description: Nitro boost acceleration for 40 ticks followed by coasting and passive nitro regeneration

scenario_7_mini_turbo.description: Drift slip qualification for >= 0.55s followed by recovery alignment (<12 deg) triggering +15% mini-turbo

scenario_8_off_road.description: Off-road handling penalty, drag, and speed-bleed on Rally Apex with AWD bonus

scenario_9_multi_car_collision_and_bound.description: Two-car mutual collision impulse exchange, tangential friction, mass weighting, and world border margin reflection
